name: battery-drain
title: Battery Drain
description: Find out why your MacBook battery drained: how many watts it draws, runaway processes, what keeps it from sleeping and how to stop it, and why charging stopped.
author: muratfe

commands.name: battery-drain
commands.title: Battery Drain
commands.subtitle: Menu Bar
commands.description: Show system power draw in the menu bar and flag runaway processes.

commands.name: diagnose-battery-drain
commands.title: Diagnose Battery Drain
commands.description: Power chart, CPU by app and process, sleep blockers and battery health.

preferences.name: runawayCpu
preferences.title: Runaway CPU (%)
preferences.description: A process at or above this share of one CPU core can be flagged as runaway.

preferences.name: runawayMinutes
preferences.title: Runaway Duration (minutes)
preferences.description: How long a process must stay above the runaway CPU share before it is flagged.

preferences.name: highWatts
preferences.title: High Power Draw (W)
preferences.description: Sustained system draw at or above this turns the Now icon in Diagnose Battery Drain orange.

preferences.name: notifyRunaways
preferences.title: Notifications
preferences.label: Notify when a runaway process is found
preferences.description: Show a macOS notification once for each runaway process.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
